name: swarm-forge
description: Disciplined tmux-based agent orchestration: pick a pack of specialist agents, give each its own git worktree, and drive them from a local web cockpit.

interface.longDescription: Run a coordinated pack of specialist coding agents in isolated git worktrees, with file-based handoffs and a local web cockpit for control.
defaultPrompt: Start a specialist swarm for this repository
Show me the current swarm status
Hand this task to the next specialist
